targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'complete') / greatest(count(*), 1), 1) AS success_pct FROM analysis_jobs WHERE dispatched_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status IN ('complete','failed')

SELECT date_trunc('hour', coalesce(completed_at, failed_at)) AS time, status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM analysis_jobs WHERE coalesce(completed_at, failed_at) > now() - interval '48 hours' AND status IN ('complete','failed') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LLM spend vs budget (this month, USD)

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(tier,'unknown') AS tier, sum(cost_usd)::float AS spent_usd FROM llm_calls WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') AND outcome = 'ok' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Ceilings: feature_flags llm_budget_{free,pro,global}_usd (env fallback). Alert wiring lands in 10.4.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback = 'helpful') / greatest(count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback IS NOT NULL), 1), 1) AS helpful_pct, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback = 'wrong') / greatest(count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback IS NOT NULL), 1), 1) AS wrong_pct FROM verdict_user_state WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: MRR proxy — active subs by price

targets.rawSql: SELECT price_id, count(*) AS subs FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('active','trialing') GROUP BY 1

panels.description: Multiply by price amounts (Stripe dashboard is authoritative for MRR).
